LanguageData.Geopol_Kesa.label: Kesa
LanguageData.Geopol_Kesa.description: The kesa is the robe of Buddhist monks and nuns. It is originally a strip of fabric dyed in ocher, made up of several assembled pieces. It is draped around the body, passing under the right arm, a flap resting on the left shoulder. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_chapeau.label: Jewish hat
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_chapeau.description: A traditional hat worn by Jewish men.
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_schtreimel.label: Schtreimel
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_schtreimel.description: The schtreimel is a fur hat worn by many Jews, especially by members of Hasidic groups, during Shabbat, religious holidays and other celebrations. Wearing this headgear helps keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_Kippa.label: Kippa
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_tenue_homme.label: Jewish attire (male)
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_tenue_homme.description: Traditional Jewish attire worn by men.
LanguageData.Geopol_Juif_tenue_femme.label: Jewish attire (female)
LanguageData.Geopol_djellaba.label: Djellaba
LanguageData.Geopol_djellaba.description: The djellaba is a long loose dress worn by both men and women, widespread as traditional clothing in North Africa. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_gilet_sans_manches.label: Sleeveless vest
LanguageData.Geopol_kufi.label: Kufi
LanguageData.Geopol_kufi.description: The kufi is a short cap intended for Muslim men. Wearing this headgear helps keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_hidjab.label: Hidjab
LanguageData.Geopol_hidjab.description: The hijab, or veil, designates a religious apparel worn by Muslim women and which covers their head leaving the face visible. Wearing this headgear helps keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_shemagh.label: Shemagh
LanguageData.Geopol_shemagh.description: Scarf worn in the Middle East, particularly in Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Jordan and by nomads; it protects against sand.
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_pretre.label: Priest's cassock
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_pretre.description: A Christian priest's cassock. This cassock is accompanied by a small wooden cross. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_eveque.label: Bishop's cassock
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_eveque.description: A Christian bishop's cassock. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_cardinal.label: Cardinal's cassock
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_cardinal.description: A Christian Cardinal's cassock. This cassock is accompanied by a small gold cross. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_nonne.label: Nun's cassock
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_nonne.description: A Christian nun's cassock. This cassock is accompanied by a small wooden cross. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_pape.label: Papal cassock
LanguageData.Geopol_soutane_pape.description: Pope's white cassock. This cassock is accompanied by a small silver cross. Wearing this apparel helps to keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_Chretien_Calotte.label: Cap
LanguageData.Geopol_Chretien_Calotte.description: The skullcap is a round headdress, worn by ecclesiastics in the Catholic liturgy. Wearing this headgear helps keep a cool head in all circumstances.
LanguageData.Geopol_Chretien_mitre.label: Miter
LanguageData.Geopol_Chretien_mitre.description: The miter is a high triangular headdress worn by bishops during liturgical ceremonies. It is in white silk, lined with red silk in the middle and embellished with embroidery in gold cloth. Wearing this headgear helps keep a cool head in all circumstances.
